modalities.evidence: electronic health record (EHR) data from ICU patients
we aggregated data from 37 clinical features from midnight to 8 AM

output.population: an internal cohort of 696 patients and 9,828 ICU days, and an external test cohort of 333 patients and 2,835 ICU days
output.summary: Daily aggregated electronic health record features for ICU patients on mechanical ventilation, with annotations of intubation, extubation, tracheostomy days and failed extubation, plus next-day extubation labels for internal and external cohorts.
